name: Samadhi of Murarbaji Deshpande
description: The samadhi (tomb) of Murarbaji Deshpande, the valiant killedar (commander) of Purandar Fort who made a heroic last stand against the Mughal army in 1665. His sacrifice is celebrated in Maratha history.
historicalSignificance: Final resting place of Murarbaji Deshpande, hero of the defense of Purandar (1665).

landmarks.name: Murarbaji Deshpande Samadhi
landmarks.description: Simple tomb, a symbol of courage and loyalty.

reviews: The story of Purandar comes alive here.
